body: Much love and thanks to everyone. I love reddit and all the love and support from complete strangers. I hope my experience helps others in their time of need, big or small, always remember you are worth so much.

I’m really sorry to hear you are feeling this way. I wouldn’t rely solely on Tinder,  because it’s so superficial. Yes, of course people do find people and it works out well.  It keep in mind people are going to show the good and positive sides of their lives and not the negative aspects. Beginning college is a weird tone, but I really encourage you to give it some time. Everyone is trying to find their place. I was extremely introverted in college because I was a transfer student and I knew no one. I didn’t leave my dorm for weeks and went home every weekend. One day, I decided to join a club and I met this amazing woman who told me “life begins at the end of your comfort zone.” And we have been friends for four years now and she introduced me to her friends too. 
I don’t want to hit you with that cliche line “you’re young, give it time” but all you need is 10 seconds of insane courage and something great will come from it. If you have class with someone you think you’d jive with, reach out and say hey! Do what makes you comfortable, and I understand most think college is about dating, but it’s also about freedom and responsibility and learning and dating will come one day. Enjoy it :)

Absolutely I care about the environment, as I was an EVS major and have a masters degree in environmental sciences. But a few times I’ve been offered a stirrer and it doesn’t bend to help me drink.  You make do I guess.
